name: Sudama Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 9th to 10th)
benefit: - Under this scheme, the girl student will get a scholarship of ₹400/- and boy student will get a scholarship of ₹300/- per year.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The applicant should be studying in Class 9 or Class 10.
   1. The student should be enrolled in a government school.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
   1. The applicant&#39;s family income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year.
   1. The applicant should have passed the previous year&#39;s class.
